tldr: Uranus through the 7th house disrupts partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 7th house, it interrupts the usual pattern around partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
